result.prompt: Use generate_image to create a polished promotional Instagram feed graphic in a 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, 1080 × 1350 pixels. Build a flat, typography-led design viewed straight on, with no perspective, photographic subjects, products, or invented branding. Fill the background with saturated scarlet red (#E32320), keeping generous clean margins and a tightly controlled red-and-white palette. Place a large warm-white (#FFFDF8) rectangular panel across the center, spanning approximately 88% of the canvas width and 42% of its height. Inside it, set the exact lettering “20% OFF · This weekend only” in scarlet, heavy condensed sans-serif type, centered and arranged across two lines: “20% OFF” dramatically oversized above “· This weekend only” in smaller but still bold lettering. Preserve the exact capitalization, percent sign, and middle dot; keep every character comfortably inside the panel. Add two thin warm-white horizontal rules near the upper and lower margins for visual structure, with no additional words, logos, icons, gradients, or shadows. Use crisp vector edges, smooth matte color fields, and uniform illumination without directional lighting or texture. Keep the composition, palette, wording, and aspect ratio fixed; review the completed still for legibility before using it as any video reference.
